investigation_resolution.ci_vs_p_value_anomaly_explained: In H1_b_minus_a, 58.2% of all bootstrap resamples had a mean of EXACTLY 0.0000 due to extreme sparsity (98.5% zeros in candidate diffs). Because the cumulative distribution is completely flat at 0.0 from percentile 1.3% to 59.5%, the 2.5th percentile evaluates to 0.0000, while the one-sided p-value (measuring boot_means <= 0.0) sums all zero resamples to yield 0.595. The two figures are mathematically consistent reflections of a discrete point-mass at zero.
investigation_resolution.methodological_limitation: The moving block bootstrap was applied to an irregularly spaced candidate stream rather than a regular time-grid of candles, inflating zero-density and distorting time-series blocks.
